about: 2026-11-01, the user: RAW played after a WCW Revenge arena keeps that arena's smaller ringside. Two CPU matches in one game: MONDAY NITRO, then SUNDAY NIGHT HEAT. qa_walls: state.csv bs_tries = the -z barricade's least z as the match's collision walks it (u16: -690 0xFD4E the game's, -530 0xFDEE Revenge's) | the +x side's (id 14: -615 / -455) << 16; bs_grabs = the least z of the walk | records << 16; bs_step = arena_current | arena_ring's ring_k << 8 | rec_n << 16. A camera on the -z side (the table / barricade). RAW's must be the game's own walls.

expect.name: the first match in MONDAY NITRO
expect.check: stage == 2 and matches == 0 and match_frames != 0xFFFF and match_frames > 30

expect.name: the second match in SUNDAY NIGHT HEAT
expect.check: stage == 2 and matches == 1 and match_frames != 0xFFFF and match_frames > 30

expect.name: nobody's position went bad
expect.check: finite(s0_x, s0_y, s0_z, s1_x, s1_y, s1_z)

expect.name: MONDAY NITRO: its own walls (the -z barricade at -530)
SUNDAY NIGHT HEAT: the game's walls (the -z barricade at -690)
SUNDAY NIGHT HEAT: never Revenge's walls
